name: Milk Punch
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Pare oranges and lemons as thin as possible.
Steep the peels in rum and brandy in a close crock for twenty-four hours.
Squeeze the fruit on sugar; add water and boiling hot new milk; then stir the rum and brandy into the above and run it through a jelly bag until perfectly clear.
Bottle and cork at once. It will keep good for some weeks.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pare oranges and lemons as thin as possible.
2. Steep the peels in rum and brandy in a close crock for twenty-four hours.
3. Squeeze the fruit on sugar; add water and boiling hot new milk; then stir the rum and brandy into the above and run it through a jelly bag until perfectly clear.
4. Bottle and cork at once. It will keep good for some weeks.
